question: What did Hezekiah say was with the king of Assyria, compared with what was with Judah?
options: Only chariots, but with us are horses
Only the arm of flesh, but with us is the LORD our God
Only a few soldiers, but with us is a great army
Only gold, but with us is silver
explanation: Hezekiah said, "With him is only the arm of flesh, but with us is the LORD our God to help us and to fight our battles."
